purpose: Retrospective attribution of JEV entry and exit judgments under a fixed target weight, using the exact completed-bar snapshot price.

window.note: 2022 minute history is used for warm-up; 2023 is the available full development year.

execution.fill_price: exact close of the completed five-minute bar shown in the same JEV snapshot
execution.purpose_note: Idealized decision-attribution diagnostic; not executable return evidence.

known_data_limitations: Five-minute labels are assumed to mark interval ends; provider semantics are unverified.
Availability is assumed at interval end; actual historical publication delay is unknown.
Security status is retrospective, not point-in-time proven.
Cash dividend event coverage in the current table is scoped to 2023-2024.
The 2023-01-01 through 2023-04-09 trading-rule interval remains uncovered by the current effective-date registry.
